title: Week 3
verification_note: Thursday routine built on DraftKings' own numbers, pulled through The Odds API at 21:02 UTC 2026-09-24 (377 requests remaining this month). No leg on tonight's Falcons-Packers game clears Rule A (+0.015 combined_edge); both Thursday tickets qualify under Rule B (own estimate above DK implied, within 6 points of Pinnacle fair, stated and flagged as thin). Green Bay -4.5 single ($10) and a Green Bay ML + Under 42.5 Same Game Parlay ($5) spend Thursday's $15 in full. Sunday and Monday boards refreshed with tonight's verified lines and preliminary reads; no new Sunday/Monday tickets added yet (final Sunday card builds Sunday morning).

tickets.name: Cardinals ML
tickets.why: combined_edge +0.022, best on the 16-game board. Brock Purdy remains out for SF (Mac Jones starts again); Kyler Murray is fully healthy for Arizona. The line already moved 3 points toward Arizona this week (open -11.5 to now -8.5), but public money is still lopsided on SF (~80% of tickets/handle) even as the number moves the other way.
tickets.kill_switch: If Brock Purdy is upgraded to probable/active at Wednesday or Thursday's practice report, pull this ticket -- SF getting its real starting QB back erases the edge. Also pull if the price shortens past +320.

legs.label: Cardinals ML
legs.why: combined_edge +0.022; own estimate 23.5% clears DK's 21.3% breakeven and matches Pinnacle's 23.5% fair. Purdy out again for SF, Murray fully healthy for ARI; public money still ~80% on SF despite the line's move toward Arizona this week.

tickets.name: Raiders +3
tickets.why: combined_edge +0.015. Sits exactly on the key number 3; Pinnacle already rates the Raiders half a point better (+3.5 fair). Saints are drawing public money as the home favorite (~56-64% of early-week action) and starting LT Kelvin Banks Jr. (high-ankle, surgery reported, possible IR) is a real, not-fully-priced hit to New Orleans' offensive line.
tickets.kill_switch: If Kelvin Banks Jr. is confirmed active/not on IR by Thursday, or the number moves off the key number to Raiders +2.5, or the price worsens past -115, pull this ticket.

tickets.name: Packers -4.5
tickets.why: combined_edge -0.015, the best price on tonight's board (thin Rule B qualifier). Green Bay's O-line losses (RT Bako-Bewele out for the year, LG Banks out) are real, but Atlanta is down starting CB A.J. Terrell (IR) and DK's own price is defending against the reverse-line-movement Atlanta money (Falcons +4.5 at -105 vs Pinnacle's fair +108, the worst leg on the board) -- the tell that Green Bay is still slightly live at this number.
tickets.kill_switch: If the 6:45 PM ET inactives add a Packers starter beyond Bako-Bewele/Banks/Reed (another O-line piece or a DB), or the number moves to GB -6 or worse before kickoff, pull this ticket. Move the freed $10 into the Under 42.5 leg of Ticket 2 as an added straight so Thursday still spends its full $15.

legs.label: Packers -4.5
legs.game: Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers
legs.why: combined_edge -0.015; own estimate 54% clears DK's 53.5% breakeven and sits inside Pinnacle's 52.0% fair band. Packers O-line down two starters, but Falcons down starting CB Terrell (IR); DK pricing defends against Atlanta's reverse-line-movement money more than Green Bay's.

tickets.name: Packers ML + Under 42.5 SGP
tickets.why: Favorite + under correlation. Green Bay ML (combined_edge -0.020, own estimate 72% vs 71.0% breakeven, Pinnacle fair 69.0%) plus Under 42.5 (combined_edge -0.027, own estimate 52% vs 50.5% breakeven, Pinnacle fair 49.8%) -- if Green Bay wins it's more likely a controlled, lower-scoring game given the O-line attrition and short week than a shootout. Thinnest leg on the card, flagged as such. Naive reference price ~+179; minimum acceptable price +130, else fall back to $2.50/$2.50 straights.
tickets.kill_switch: If Green Bay loses another O-line starter on the 6:45 PM inactives beyond what's priced, drop the ML leg and put the full $5 on Under 42.5 alone. If the total moves to 44.5+ before kickoff, drop the Under leg and take $5 straight on Green Bay ML at -245 or better. If the SGP builder won't clear +130, split into $2.50 on Green Bay ML and $2.50 on Under 42.5.
